_about: Catalog of project MCP servers. No secrets here. tools/mcpgen.py fills {KEY} from the chosen account's KEY__ACCOUNT values in .env and writes a git-ignored .mcp.json at the kit root. Verify a URL against the vendor docs (links below) before trusting it.

retell.warning: One tool, invoke_api_endpoint, reaches every endpoint the key can, including delete and publish. Never always-allow it.

n8n.warning: Instance-level MCP: n8n Settings > Instance-level MCP. The token is not the REST API key. update_workflow and publish_workflow change live workflows.

make.warning: The token sits in the URL. Make profile > API access > MCP token, separate from MAKE_API_TOKEN. scenarios_run and scenarios_update act on live scenarios.
